text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right, sent the letter back home.
Time to head to training—

text_block_list.name: Arcade Customer A
text_block_list.text: There's no way we can win!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "There's no way to win"? Who can't win against whom?

text_block_list.name: Arcade Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm talking about this new game.
Honestly, it's straight-up impossible.

text_block_list.name: Arcade Customer B
text_block_list.text:
The characters available right now are all trash.
Shouldn't we just wait until the top-tier ones drop?

text_block_list.name: Arcade Customers
text_block_list.text:
—H-holy crap!?? I won?!
—Wait, there's no way I can beat the next enemy!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, Trainer.
If I back down here, it'd ruin my name as an ace!

Katsuragi Ace got so engrossed in her game
that she ended up skipping training entirely.
